title: Monarch Uncategorized Spend Backlog
app: Monarch Money, Copilot Money, Plaid-connected accounts, Plaid investments, and brokerage CSV exports ingested into Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monarch:transaction
| where category="Uncategorized"
| stats count as uncategorized_transactions by account_name
| sort - uncategorized_transactions
description: Uses Monarch Money exports telemetry to monitor how many transactions still lack a proper category in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for budget data that is degrading because cleanup never happened, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Monarch Money exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Account table of uncategorized transaction counts.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how many transactions still lack a proper category so you can spot budget data that is degrading because cleanup never happened before it becomes annoying.
